words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) keeps 102:2 from sounding like a fresh, independent report. It opens with dependency, carrying the previous verb {{ar:أَلْهَاكُمُ}} ({{tr:alhākumu}}) into the current ayah and making {{ar:زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ}} ({{tr:zurtumu l-maqābira}}) the endpoint of that diversion. The strongest local grammar is temporal limit: the competitive absorption lasts until the grave-arrival. The result nuance also survives, but only as qualified pressure, because the same wording can make the diversion feel as though it issues in that arrival rather than merely continuing up to it. Placed first after the ayah break, the particle turns the break into continuation, and its doubled stop plus final long sound make the small boundary word feel audibly weighty before the verb names the arrival.

words.prose: {{ar:زُرْتُمُ}} ({{tr:zurtumu}}) is a perfect verb inside the scope of {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}), so the graveward action is subordinated to the distraction named in 102:1. Its past form makes the endpoint sound already accomplished, collapsing the distance between present rivalry and future death. The attached second-person plural ending keeps the same accused audience in view: the ones affected by distraction become the ones who arrive. Because the object is {{ar:ٱلْمَقَابِرَ}} ({{tr:al-maqābira}}), the ordinary visit sense is selected, yet the pairing with graves lets the wording remain euphemistic, so death is spoken as a visit and not as a blunt death verb. The spare verb-object beat reduces the wide motion of {{ar:ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ}} ({{tr:al-takāthuru}}) to one action and one destination, with no intervening clause for delay. The broader {{ar:ز و ر}} ({{tr:z-w-r}}) field can involve turning aside and falsehood; here those branches do not replace visiting, but they make the visit expose the prior life of {{ar:ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ}} ({{tr:al-takāthuru}}) as a misdirected route. The Form I simplicity also matters: against swerving language elsewhere (18:17), this word moves directly toward the graveyard, and the next ayah's rebuke and future knowing (102:3) keep the completed arrival from becoming silence.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَقَابِرَ}} ({{tr:al-maqābira}}) is not a loose background setting; it is the accusative direct object of {{ar:زُرْتُمُ}} ({{tr:zurtumu}}), so the clause lands on the graveyard as the thing reached. Its definite plural form makes the destination feel shared and already known, while the place-noun pattern names a cemetery-domain rather than one individual grave container. That form matters after {{ar:ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ}} ({{tr:al-takāthuru}}): a public multiplication is answered by a collective place where bodies are buried and hidden. The object relation keeps literal grave-visiting and euphemistic death open together, and the visitor verb keeps the graveyard from being simple final silence. Later grave-disclosure scenes (82:4; 100:9) show the same root horizon moving from concealment toward exposure, and the next ayah's rebuke (102:3) likewise reopens what this final noun seems to close. As the last word, longer and heavier than the verb, {{ar:ٱلْمَقَابِرَ}} ({{tr:al-maqābira}}) absorbs the action into the destination.

topics.reason: The syntax fixes the object relation, but the visit verb plus grave object allows both literal graveyard-going and euphemistic death without changing the noun's concrete sense.

topics.reason: V4 supports grave, burial, and hiddenness branches for {{ar:ق ب ر}} ({{tr:q-b-r}}), while local grammar selects the cemetery place noun; concealment therefore survives as root image rather than a separate local act.

topics.headline: place noun names a cemetery-domain

topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:ٱلْمَقَابِرَ}} ({{tr:al-maqābira}}) as a place/time noun plural, supporting the CRITICAL distinction between cemetery-domain and individual grave containers.

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete references to grave-disclosure contexts (82:4; 100:9), and the local noun's burial/concealment sense makes the contrast meaningful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The limit particle حَتَّى, the perfect second-person plural زُرْتُم, and the plural destination ٱلْمَقَابِرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary visitation supplies arrival without lexical ownership of the destination, while the burial-place branch identifies that destination as the resting place of the dead. The limit construction therefore reaches death while retaining a live asymmetry: those buried are described as visitors, so the grave is a terminal boundary in the sentence but not securely a permanent home in the visitor image.

activation_trace.role: Visiting and turning toward someone supplies a purposeful arrival whose visitor relation remains temporary.
Burial and the place of graves fix the destination as actual mortuary space rather than an abstract limit.

changed_reading.before: You continued until you reached the graves and died.
changed_reading.after: You crossed the limit into burial, yet the verb casts even that arrival as a visit: the grave is a reached station whose permanence the wording pointedly withholds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion in زُرْتُم directed toward the plural ٱلْمَقَابِرَ can activate side branches of both focus roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The visit remains the overt event, but the same motion root also carries turning aside, and the grave root carries hiddenness, depression, and enclosure. Together they spatialize the clause as a course that bends away and sinks inward; حَتَّى measures not merely elapsed time but the full extent of that diversion.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary visit keeps the model attached to the clause's actual directed motion.
Turning aside and deviation bend the visitor's route away from an intended course.
Hiddenness, inward sinking, and sealed enclosure give the route a downward and occluding terminus.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a neutral visit to a cemetery.
changed_reading.after: The verse images a trajectory permitted to bend all the way into hidden, sunken enclosure: the cemetery is the geometry of a completed diversion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collective subject turns toward plural graves through a verb whose root also contains a social point-of-recourse branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside physical visitation, the root can organize people around a chief or reference point toward which they incline. Coupled with burial places, this leaves a social reading in which the living turn toward the buried dead not only as destinations but as sources of standing, precedent, or orientation.

activation_trace.role: A point of recourse or leadership supplies the social topology of a group inclining toward an authority.
The burial-place image locates that possible recourse among the dead.

changed_reading.before: A group physically arrives at burial grounds.
changed_reading.after: The living may also be turning toward the buried as collective reference points; the graveyard becomes a social archive of authority as well as a destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attention is captured by a contest of numerical superiority, and حَتَّى carries that contest into the focus clause. Because the focus supplies collective visitors and plural graves, the cemetery can become the rivalry's last evidence pool: competitors recruit buried people, lineages, or grave-sites into the count. This coexists with the simpler temporal reading in which death finally stops the contest.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful visitation lets the competitive group actively go to the mortuary field rather than merely expire.
The plural place of burial supplies a concrete archive of dead persons or sites available to the contest.
Being occupied by one thing away from another makes the contest an attention-capturing process with momentum.
Outdoing others through number supplies the comparative counting operation that can extend into the graves.

structural_cues: 102:1 immediately precedes 102:2, and حَتَّى grammatically binds its distraction and rivalry to the focus limit.
The second-person plural subject and plural ٱلْمَقَابِرَ permit a public comparison spanning multiple dead or burial sites.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diverted attention, numerical outdoing, purposeful visitation, and plural graves; I supply the arrow that the rivalry uses the buried as countable evidence. A live alternative is that no counting occurs in the cemetery and death simply terminates the distraction.

changed_reading.before: Competition in increase continues only until death cuts it off.
changed_reading.after: Competition may be so absorptive that it does not merely end at the cemetery; it annexes the cemetery as its final scoreboard, while the death-as-termination reading remains live.

context_deltas.mechanism: The grave's side image is hidden, sunken enclosure, but the next sequence repeatedly promises disclosure and then stabilizes it as certainty. This creates an epistemic inversion: entry into the place that hides the body becomes the narrative threshold after which what distraction concealed can no longer stay concealed.

activation_trace.role: The visit supplies the crossing event between the prior condition and the later epistemic sequence.
Hiddenness and inward enclosure establish the concealment that the following disclosures reverse.
The first promised knowing supplies the initial uncovering immediately after the grave visit.
Repeated disclosure makes the post-grave uncovering staged or emphatic rather than incidental.
The paired verb and noun concentrate knowing into an explicit state of revealed understanding.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed turns disclosure into irreversible certainty.

structural_cues: The future-knowing clause recurs in 102:3 and 102:4, then expands into verb-plus-cognate-noun in 102:5.
The focus visit stands immediately before this escalating sequence, with حَتَّى already marking a threshold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grave-hiddenness, repeated disclosure, and doubtless stability; I infer the reversal from entering concealment to undergoing exposure. The alternative is simple temporal succession—knowledge follows death—without any semantic work being done by the grave's hiddenness branch.

changed_reading.before: The grave hides the dead and ends their worldly perception.
changed_reading.after: The hidden grave becomes a paradoxical epistemic hinge: bodily concealment is followed by escalating, stabilized disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus-side branch permits speech to be composed or cosmetically straightened, while the grave hides its occupants. The split inventory at the later seeing verb activates both transmitted report and direct vision; repeated seeing, the blazing object seen, the eye, and certainty then move authority from editable accounts to witnessed actuality. On this reading, visiting graves is the border where curated claims about the dead or their prestige lose control of the evidence.

activation_trace.role: The actual visit keeps the proposed media transition located at the encounter with graves.
Preparing and improving speech supplies the editable, potentially cosmetic register of social claims.
The dead person's hidden enclosure permits reputation to circulate without immediate visual checking.
The non-dominant mapped branch of transmitting news or verse activates mediated report as one possible channel.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies direct apprehension that can displace the mediated report.
Blazing and intense heat gives direct vision a resistant, non-cosmetic object.
The repeated act of seeing reinforces the transfer from hearsay or crafted speech to encounter.
Ocular witnessing specifies that the encounter is immediate rather than merely narrated.
Doubtless stability closes the gap in which curated reports could compete with what is seen.

structural_cues: 102:6 and 102:7 repeat the seeing verb; the second occurrence adds an explicit eye-and-certainty construction.
The packet itself preserves a non-dominant report-transmission inventory beside the dominant vision inventory for the same context occurrences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech-shaping, hiddenness, a split between report and sight, repeated vision, a blazing object, and certainty; I infer a temporal transfer of evidentiary authority at the graves. A live alternative is that the report branch is only a mapping echo and that the context activates literal sight with no contrast to curated ancestral claims.

changed_reading.before: The graves are a destination around which claims about the dead may continue to circulate.
changed_reading.after: The grave visit marks the failure point of edited reputation: transmitted or ornamented accounts give way to an immediate spectacle that cannot be revised.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names the entrants as visitors, a relation that implies temporary tenure and can include hospitality. The closing context combines a demand for an answer with good condition, ease, and pleasant lodging. Read together, enjoyed comforts look less like accumulated property and more like hospitality entrusted to temporary guests; the grave visit becomes checkout before an account is requested.

activation_trace.role: The visitor relation supplies temporary tenure and the possibility of received hospitality.
The burial place supplies the threshold at which the prior stay is relinquished.
Questioning and requesting supplies the demand for an account after the temporary stay.
Good condition and favor identify what was enjoyed and is now placed under inquiry.
An agreeable place and pleasant stay sharpen the hospitality and lodging analogy.

structural_cues: 102:8 follows the grave visit through the surah's repeated ثُمَّ sequence and uses emphatic future passive questioning.
The inquiry is explicitly about comfort or favor, while the focus has already chosen visitor language for the mortal transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visitation, burial, questioning, favor, and pleasant stay; I supply the guest-to-checkout-to-account arrow. The live alternative is ordinary accountability for blessings with no hospitality metaphor and no special causal role for the visitor branch.

changed_reading.before: People enjoy comforts, die, and are later questioned about those comforts.
changed_reading.after: People are temporary guests amid entrusted comforts; visiting the graves is checkout from that stay before the hospitality received is called to account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes remote material side branches into a machine-and-terrain analogy, not a lexical paraphrase. It remains anchored in the focus through its hard-going visit and sunken grave, and in the immediate context through mill-feeding and billowing increase. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory material model of compulsive momentum, never claim that the surface words literally denote a mill or dust storm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The visit root's hard-driving branch and the grave root's depressed hidden place remain attached to زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ.

activation_trace.role: Hard driving pace turns the focus visit into accelerated, difficult motion.
A hidden depression gives the accelerating process a hollow into which it finally sinks.
Casting material into a mill's mouth supplies a self-feeding mechanism for the distraction.
A thickening cloud of dust makes increase the residue and obscuring atmosphere of the driven process.

changed_reading.before: A social obsession lasts until its participants reach the cemetery.
changed_reading.after: The obsession behaves like a fed mill or driven mechanism: it consumes inputs, thickens its own obscuring dust, accelerates its subjects, and deposits them in hidden hollows.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain spatial activation: a grave-depression is analogized to an eye-like opening because later branches supply showing, blazing visibility, and an ocular depression. It remains validly anchored to the focus grave's hidden sunken form and the visitor's passage, but downstream prose should present it as a paradoxical aperture image, not as a claim that a grave is etymologically an eye.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hidden, depressed ٱلْمَقَابِرَ reached by visitors can be spatially reversed by the later eye-and-showing sequence.

activation_trace.role: Visitation supplies passage to and through the spatial threshold.
Hiddenness and a sunken enclosure provide the initially opaque depression.
Causing something to appear reverses the grave's initial function of concealment.
Blazing heat supplies the forcefully visible scene beyond the opaque depression.
An eye-like hollow or localized depression lets the grave-pit be re-imaged as an aperture rather than a seal.

changed_reading.before: The grave is an opaque hollow that removes its occupant from view.
changed_reading.after: The grave-hollow can become a paradoxical aperture: the visitor enters concealment only for the depression to open onto unavoidable manifestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant split inventory attached to the later questioning root, so it is especially branch-distant. It remains anchored because the focus explicitly combines a temporary visit with hidden enclosure and the context supplies covert drawing-out or egress. Downstream prose must qualify it as a packet-triggered extraction image, not redefine the surface questioning verb as physical extraction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Temporary visiting and the grave root's sealed inwardness leave open a motion out of the enclosure as well as motion into it.

activation_trace.role: The visitor image makes enclosure a stay from which departure remains structurally imaginable.
Hidden inward sinking and sealed containment supply what must be exited or opened.
Gentle or hidden drawing-out activates removal from the sealed state before the account.
Slipping out supplies the complementary egress motion latent in a visit rather than permanent residence.

changed_reading.before: The visit ends with occupants enclosed and hidden in graves.
changed_reading.after: The grave is a temporary sealed chamber in a larger motion: entry into hiddenness is paired, exploratorily, with being drawn or slipping back out before questioning.

strongest_changes: The cemetery is both the point where numerical rivalry stops and, in a coexisting reading, the last archive that rivalry annexes as evidence.
The grave's hiddenness reverses into an epistemic threshold: concealment is followed by repeated disclosure, sight, and stabilized certainty.
A split report-versus-vision activation turns the grave visit into the failure point of curated reputation and the onset of uneditable witness.
Visitor language plus final questioning recasts enjoyed comfort as temporary hospitality subject to an account.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause is unusually productive because 'visit' refuses to make the grave a possessed home, while side branches turn the same motion toward deviation, social recourse, and prepared speech. Context does not collapse these into one lesson: it supports rival scoreboard and endpoint readings, a concealment-to-disclosure reversal, a report-to-witness shift, and a guest-accounting model. Non-dominant split inventories additionally preserve contained aperture and extraction images.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether حَتَّى merely terminates the rivalry at death or permits the rivalry to continue by counting and invoking the buried.
Whether temporary visitor language positively implies onward movement or only avoids specifying permanence.
Whether the non-dominant report and extraction branches are genuine activators here or packet-induced echoes that should remain only as outliers.
Whether the hospitality model is licensed by the visitor and pleasant-stay branches or overextends them into a host-and-checkout scenario.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The grave as a visited station, not possessed endpoint.** Branch evidence: ز و ر B003, visiting and turning toward someone; ق ب ر B001, grave/cemetery; س ء ل B001, questioning; ر ء ي B001, seeing. Structural cue: "حتى" gives a limit to the distraction, while "زرتم" uses visiting language for the cemetery. Assigned role: ز و ر B003 makes the grave a place of temporary arrival; سأل/رأي make what follows an onward exposure. Abductive move: I infer from later questioning and seeing that the visit does not close the sequence. Reading change: the ayah reads as a threshold-visit into disclosure, not a final stop.

2. **Deviation reaches the graves.** Branch evidence: ز و ر B001, turning aside/deviation; ز و ر B002, falsehood and invalid speech; ل ه و B001, diversion; ك ث ر B002, rivalry; ق ب ر B001, graves. Structural cue: the root of "visit" also carries deviation and falsehood branches, and the previous ayah has a diversion caused by rivalry. Assigned role: ز و ر B001/B002 color the "visit" as a swerving course produced by false evaluation. Abductive move: I infer that the same movement toward a place can disclose the crookedness of the path that led there. Reading change: "you visited the graves" reads not only as arrival at death but as the spatial proof that the earlier life-course had bent away.

3. **Hiddenness awaiting marks and sight.** Branch evidence: ق ب ر B002, hiddenness and inward sinking; ع ل م B002, distinguishing mark/landmark; ر ء ي B012, showing and making seen; ع ي ن B002, face-to-face seeing. Structural cue: after the grave, the surah repeats "you will know" and then "you will see." Assigned role: the grave hides; علم/رأي/عين later mark and expose. Abductive move: I supply the temporal arrow: what goes inward at قبر becomes legible through later knowledge and sight. Reading change: the cemetery becomes a concealment-device that paradoxically prepares revelation.

4. **Hard-driven movement to the limit.** Branch evidence: ز و ر B007, hard driving pace; ك ث ر B002, rivalry; "حتى" as sequence-limit. Structural cue: the motion verb is framed by a preceding compulsion-like occupation and a terminal "until." Assigned role: ز و ر B007 supplies velocity and pressure to the journey. Abductive move: I infer that rivalry does not merely accompany movement but drives it hard toward its limit. Reading change: the ayah can be heard as an acceleration into the cemetery, not a neutral visit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 102:7 most changed this ayah: "عين اليقين" made زرتم المقابر read as an interim visit before a direct encounter with the thing itself, not as final arrival. 102:8 added another surprise through ن ع م B011/B012, pleasant settlement and walking on foot; the grave-visit is retrospectively one leg in a whole path of dwelling, movement, and eventual questioning. The hiddenness of قبر B002 became stronger after the later seeing-language, because concealment now looks like the stage before exposure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A temporary act at a place of apparent settlement.** Fixed `زُرْتُمُ` anchors `ز و ر B003` (visiting and intentionally turning toward someone), while fixed `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ` anchors `ق ب ر B001` (the dead person's grave and resting place). The conjunction `حَتَّىٰ` makes this encounter the limit of the preceding rivalry, yet 102:3–7 continue from graves into knowledge and direct sight. Visit supplies temporariness; grave supplies enclosure and apparent repose. I infer from the continuation that the visitors do not reach their final endpoint there. The ayah consequently recasts the cemetery from terminal destination into a threshold on a longer itinerary.

2. **The end-point of a bent course.** Fixed `ز و ر B001` contributes turning aside or deviation as a dormant coloring of the visit-form. Structurally, contextual `ل ه و B001` has already described being turned from one concern by another, and `ك ث ر B002` names the rivalry that drives the course until the graves. The branch's assigned role is spatial: distraction becomes a path bent away from its proper bearing. The packet does not state that rivalry causes deviation; I supply that directional arrow from occupation to misorientation. `زُرْتُمُ` then registers more than arrival: the grave-visit exposes where a repeatedly diverted trajectory has actually led.

3. **A concealment chamber that cannot prevent manifestation.** Fixed `ق ب ر B002` gathers hiddenness, sinking, hollowness, and enclosure. Later in the clipped window, `ع ل م B001` repeats as disclosure, `ي ق ن B001` removes doubt, and 102:6–7 move to `ر ء ي B001` and contextual `ع ي ن B002` (face-to-face seeing). The graves' assigned role is the maximum spatial concealment between distraction and manifestation. I infer that what is sunk from present sight remains available for later disclosure; the packet gives the sequence but not that causal rule. `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ` therefore reads as delayed visibility rather than erasure: burial interrupts ordinary sight but is structurally overcome by knowing and eyewitness certainty.

4. **Exploratory: entry into the place where competitive appearances fail.** Fixed `ز و ر B002` supplies falsehood or validity bent away from truth, and fixed `ق ب ر B002` supplies hiddenness. These dormant branches are activated by the movement from status-rivalry (`ك ث ر B002`) to repeated knowing and seeing. False appearance is assigned to the public ranking produced by rivalry; hiddenness is assigned to the grave that removes those displays. I infer, rather than read explicitly, that competitive status depends on crafted appearances and that burial strips them away. On this reading, the grave-visit is an epistemic collapse of social display, preparing the later disclosure of what the display concealed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repeated knowing of 102:3–5 already weakened any terminal reading of `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ`, but 102:7 supplied the decisive surprise: `ع ي ن B002` makes manifestation face to face. That later directness retrospectively sharpened fixed `ق ب ر B002` from generic burial into temporary concealment and fixed `ز و ر B003` from ordinary arrival into a genuinely transitional visit.

Defin görünürlüğü geçici olarak keser; sonraki bilgi ve görme, gizlenenin silinmediğini, açığa çıkmayı beklediğini gösterir.
Çokluk yarışının baskısı, mezara doğru nötr bir yolculuk değil, son sınıra hızla sürülen bir hareket üretir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Attention is drawn away from one object, absorbed by pleasure, redirected toward social desire, or deliberately solicited from an audience.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Diversion ranges from inward neglect to play, intimate attraction, reputation management, and the refusal of social shame.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Intimate and Social Diversion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Desire is directed toward intimate companions, offspring, or repeated social courtship and conversation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intimate euphemism `ل ه و:B002/m02`; variant intimate euphemism `ل ه ي:B002/m02`; recurrent courtship and conversation `ز و ر:B003/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); 102:2 `زُرْتُمُ` (`ز و ر`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Diversion acquires participants and a social setting: the sought pleasure may be a person, a family attachment, or repeated conversational courtship.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Directed movement culminates in arrival, social reception, settlement, or emplacement in a final resting place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The movement ranges from speed and foot travel to hospitality, congenial residence, burial, and the provision of a grave.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fast and Pedestrian Travel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler advances either with speed or directly on foot, with the feet bearing the cost of movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rapid travel `ز و ر:B007/m01`; pedestrian journey `ن ع م:B012/m01`; worn feet `ن ع م:B012/m02`; light walking `ن ع م:B012/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Travel is differentiated by manner: forceful speed contrasts with unmounted movement, while foot-wear and lightness register the body's participation in the journey.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Directed movement culminates in arrival, social reception, settlement, or emplacement in a final resting place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The movement ranges from speed and foot travel to hospitality, congenial residence, burial, and the provision of a grave.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Visit and Reception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A visitor intentionally approaches another party and enters a social frame of reception and hospitality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visit and visitor `ز و ر:B003/m01`; guest hospitality `ز و ر:B003/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Visiting has direction, an arriving participant, and a receiving side. Hospitality develops the destination from a place into a social encounter.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Directed movement culminates in arrival, social reception, settlement, or emplacement in a final resting place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The movement ranges from speed and foot travel to hospitality, congenial residence, burial, and the provision of a grave.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Settlement and Final Emplacement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Arrival resolves into a fitting place of residence or into burial within a grave and cemetery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: congenial land `ن ع م:B011/m01`; pleasant settlement `ن ع م:B011/m02`; grave as resting place `ق ب ر:B001/m01`; burial `ق ب ر:B001/m02`; provision of a grave `ق ب ر:B001/m03`; cemetery `ق ب ر:B001/m04`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Residence and burial share the operation of assigning a body to a place. One setting welcomes continued dwelling; the other receives the dead and fixes their final station.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Heat intensifies from material combustion into destructive conflict, bodily anger, and a burning or fixed gaze.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Fire becomes a model for warfare, facial inflammation, anger, and the eye's severe visual force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Anger Igniting the Face
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Inner anger rises as heat and becomes visible in the face and an aggressive nasal posture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: face inflamed by anger `ج ح م:B004/m01`; nose-raised anger posture `ق ب ر:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: An inward emotional surge is externalized through heated facial appearance and a projecting posture, making anger bodily legible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A single identifying logic connects cloth marks, road guides, boundaries, banners, chiefs, selected objects, nobles, and full siblings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Standards and Public Authority
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A raised sign makes a collective center visible, while a chief or reference figure gives the group a point of return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: banner as mark `ع ل م:B002/m02`; raised standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; chief or authority `ز و ر:B005/m01`; point of reference `ز و ر:B005/m02`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ground, fruit, decayed wood, skin, a protected chamber, a lung, and a waterskin all share an inside-outside organization.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Raptors, Larks, and Ostriches

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlamın çekirdeğini bir doğrultudan yana eğilme, amaçlanan yönden ayrılma ve başka yana dönme olarak açıkça kurar. Çöl, kuyu, kap ve yay örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı fiziksel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel eğilme ve yönünden ayrılmadır; yalan, ziyaret, göğüs veya yöneticilik anlamlarını kendi kapsamına almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı olmayan eğilme ve yön değiştirme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılması, başka yana dönmesi veya fiziksel olarak yana eğilmesidir. Bu çekirdek, eğri biçimli nesnelere ve bakış ya da duruştaki yana kaymaya uygulanabilir.

facets.statement: Amaçlanan yön, yol veya duruştan yana doğru ayrılma ve başka tarafa dönme.
Bir nesnenin biçiminde, bir canlının duruşunda veya bakışında fiziksel yana eğrilik bulunması.
Yolundan uzaklaşmış arazi, dibi uzak kuyu, eğri kap ve yay bu yönelme biçiminin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yön veya amaç çizgisinden ayrılma ile fiziksel yana eğilmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; nesne ve duruş örnekleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılmayı hem de fiziksel yana eğrilik gösteren yalın kullanımları birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yön değişmesi, amaçtan ayrılma ve fiziksel eğilme çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne, gövde veya bakışın fiziksel olarak bir yana kaydığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yana kayma ve eğrilik anlamını eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, orta çizgiden ayrılmanın yanında bir kişiye destek için yönelmeyi ve çok çeşitli yapısal eğrilikleri de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak komşu dalın destek amacıyla birine yönelme ve geniş yapısal eğrilik alanı odak dalın sınırını aşar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda ayrılınan doğrultu belirleyicidir; komşu dalda ise başka bir şeye doğru yönelme veya dayanma ilişkisi belirginleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gerçekten ayrılmış söz anlamındaki yalanı ve buna bağlı olarak doğru kabul edilmemesi gereken tapınma nesnesini birlikte tanıklar. Yalancı tanıklık ve doğru olmayan söz, yalan çekirdeğinin belirli kullanımlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalan ve gerçekten sapmış batıl şeylerle sınırlıdır; ziyaret, fiziksel eğilme ve sözü konuşmadan önce düzenleme bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın yalan ve batıl nesne anlamlarını hem de doğru olmayan söz kalıbını içerir; söz kalıbının kapsamı yalın biçimin bütün anlamlarına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gerçekten ve doğrudan ayrılmış söz, hüküm veya tanıklıktır. Bu sapma düşüncesi, hak etmediği halde tanrılaştırılıp tapınılan nesnenin adlandırılmasına da genişler.

facets.statement: Gerçekle uyuşmayan, doğruluktan ayrılmış yalan veya batıl içerik.
Doğru olmayan söz ve yalancı tanıklık biçimindeki söz öbeğine bağlı kullanım.
Gerçek tanrılık niteliği taşımadığı halde tanrılaştırılıp tapınılan nesne.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yalanı doğruluk yolundan sapma olarak açıklar, yalancı tanıklığı bunun sözlü gerçekleşmesi sayar ve aynı adlandırmayı batıl tapınma nesnesine genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: gerçekten sapmış yalan veya batıl nesne

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiye yönelip onu görmeye gitme eylemini, bu eylemi yapan kişiyi ve topluluğu açıkça tanıklar. Ziyaretçiyi ağırlama ile kadınlarla sık görüşen erkek anlamları, aynı alandaki özel ve bağımlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal birini görmek üzere ona yönelme ve bunun katılımcılarıyla sınırlıdır; konukluk, yalın yönelme veya tel ve keten anlamları bu çekirdeğe katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım görmeye gitme eylemini temel alır ve özel kişi ya da ağırlama kullanımlarını bu çekirdeğe bağımlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi görmek veya onunla buluşmak amacıyla yanına gitmek ve ona yönelmektir; bu eylemi yapan kişi ya da topluluk da aynı anlam alanındadır. Ziyaretçiyi ağırlama ve kadınlarla sık görüşüp sohbet eden erkek anlamları özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi görmek veya onunla buluşmak için yanına gitme ve ona yönelme.
Görmeye giden kişi ile bu kişilerden oluşan topluluğun adlandırılması.
Görmeye gelen kişiyi iyi karşılayıp ağırlama.
Kadınların yanına sık gidip onlarla görüşmeyi ve sohbet etmeyi seven erkek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, görmeye gitme eylemi ile ziyaretçi ve ziyaretçi topluluğunu ortak biçimde tanıklar; ağırlama ve kadınlarla sık görüşen erkek kullanımları bu alanın özel uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylemin temel yönelme ve buluşma amacını verir; kişi, topluluk ve özel uzantılar bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi göğsün üst veya orta bölümünü ve bu bölümdeki eğriliği doğrudan tanıklar. Göğse bağlanan kayış ile hayvanın ağzını çevirmeye yarayan araç ilişkili kullanımlardır; güçlü kişi anlamı ise kaynağın olağan çekirdeğin dışında saydığı ayrı bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım göğüs bölgesi ve buradaki eğrilik çekirdeğini korur; araç adlarını ve güçlü kişi kullanımını çekirdekle eşitlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın göğüs bölgesi ve göğüsteki eğrilik anlamına dayanır; araç ve kişi kullanımları bu yalın çekirdeğin bağımlı uzantıları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Göğsün üst veya orta bölümü ile bu bölgede görülen yana eğriliktir. Göğse bağlanan araçlar ilişkili adlandırmalar, güçlü ve sert kişi anlamı ise olağan çekirdeğin dışındaki bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvanda göğsün üst ya da orta bölümü.

Devenin göğsüne bağlanan kayış veya bir hayvanın ağzını çevirmeye yarayan araç.
Göğsün gücüyle ilişkilendirilerek güçlü ve sert kişi için verilen sıra dışı kullanım.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göğsün üst veya orta bölümünde ve buradaki eğrilikte birleşir; göğse bağlanan araçlar ilişki yoluyla, güçlü kişi anlamı ise sıra dışı bir uzantı olarak verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gömü alanı üzerinden ölümü anlatma, gömülü olanın dirilişte veya sırların açığa çıkışında ortaya çıkarılması, insanın durumlarının gizli sayılması, kâfir ile cahilin dünyadayken gömülmüş diye nitelenmesi ve bazı kişilerin ölüler hükmünde görülmesi gibi birkaç mecazi yön verir. Bunlar tek bir 'gizlenme' anlamına indirgenmemeli, gömülme imgesine bağlı ayrı aktarımlar olarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek gömü yerini adlandırmaz; ölüm, gizlilik, açığa çıkma, kâfir ile cahilin gömülmüş diye nitelenmesi ve ölüler hükmünde olma yönlerini mecazi kullanımlarla sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mecazi anlamlar belirli söz kalıpları ve türemiş biçimlere bağlıdır; ölüm veya gizlilik anlamı yalın gömü adı için genel anlam sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gömü ve gömülme imgesi, ölümün dolaylı anlatımı, gizli durumların gömülmüş sayılması, gömülü olanın dirilişte ya da sırlar açığa çıktığında ortaya çıkarılması, kâfir ile cahilin dünyadayken gömülmüş diye nitelenmesi ve bazı kişilerin ölüler hükmünde görülmesi için mecazen kullanılır.

facets.statement: Gömü alanına varma sözü ölümün dolaylı anlatımı olabilir.
Gömülerde olanın çıkarılması, diriliş durumunu veya gizli sırların açığa çıkmasını anlatır.
İnsanın dünyadaki durumları, henüz açığa çıkmadıkları için gömülmüşçesine gizli sayılır.
Kâfir ile cahil, dünyadayken gömülmüş diye nitelenir.
Bazı kişiler ölüler hükmünde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalda birden çok kaynağın ortak katmanı yoktur; ölüm, dirilişte açığa çıkma, gizli durumlar, kâfir ile cahilin gömülmüş diye nitelenmesi ve ölü hükmünde sayılma yönleri tek kaynaklı bir açıklamada toplanır.
